content.title: BWI Thurgood Marshall Airport (BWI)
content.text: Dustin BorntregerLast Monday I went from the long term parking lot, shuttle, checked bag, security and to my gate in 32 minutes.48Bruce A Verbus IISomething I have never understood is why airports scheduled security times. Kind of like cruise lines have for check in times. If it's within your check in time you go in this line. If it's not your time yet you go in another line.38Chris JacobsLiterally just dropped my wife off at the airport. All the lines at 4am was with Southwest kiosk then the really long line was at the bag drop. There was no line at TSA. My wife walked right up and through. They had the general boarding, TSA pre and TSA touch-less lines open at the time. This was at 430am this morning.22Corey DowningTo be fair, I just made it from the front door, through baggage check, and through TSA in 6 minutes exactly. So experiences may vary.14Kat EblingAre airlines bag drop staff there earlier to accommodate checked bags?15Chris Angelini ElrodI flew out on Thursday , no line at all. Today is going to be one of the busiest travel days because all the college students, and many public school kids who took famiy vacations are all coming back from spring break. On top of all the normal travelers.14Catherine LudwigJust dropped my son off, he checked his bag and was through TSA in 20 minutes. Only one check point open so will get busier as the day wakes up more.6Ralph CapenChucky claimed ownership of this Schutdown before it started!12Shawny LavineI went through yesterday afternoon, 15 minutes. The long lines were people at the ticket counter checking in their bags and getting a printable boarding pass. Word to the wise have a carry on and download your boarding ticket to your phone. Easy peasy2Glenn JanzenIf you have a 6am departure, then gate time is probably 5:20am. So arriving for TSA is 2:20 am, are the airline ticket counters open for checked bags?2
